**Changes** (matching the upstream fix for CVE-2024-39338, axios PR #6539):

1. **`lib/helpers/isAbsoluteURL.js`** — protocol-relative URLs (`//host`) are no longer treated as absolute. 2. **`lib/adapters/http.js:232`** — URL parsing no longer uses `'http://localhost'` as an implicit base. A protocol-relative URL with no `baseURL` now raises `Invalid URL` server-side (the expected pre-1.3.2 behavior) instead of silently resolving to an arbitrary host.
